title: Account for property, plant, and equipment related costs after acquisition

items.concept: Classify and record post-acquisition PPE costs (expense vs capitalize); substitution removal of old roof; capitalize addition and rearrangement; period-end depreciation adjusting JE; subsequent measurement schedule
Number-variant twin — ordinary repair; HVAC substitution removal; addition; rearrangement; accident loss; subsequent measurement schedule; period-end depreciation adjusting JE
